model: KAJPLATS LED bulb E27 1055 lm, colour and white spectrum (706.085.75)
name: IKEA KAJPLATS E27 1055 lm Smart Colour and White Spectrum Bulb (EU)

radios.note: IKEA describes it as Matter over Thread. The CSA listing gives Thread and Bluetooth as transports; Bluetooth is presumably for Matter commissioning.

matter.note: CSA lists 'KAJPLATS E27 CWS globe 1055lm' as Matter-certified (certified 2025-12-16) with Thread and Bluetooth transport.

apple_home.note: IKEA names Apple among compatible systems; works via Matter over Thread and needs a Thread border router.

google_home.note: IKEA names Google among compatible systems; works via Matter over Thread and needs a Thread border router.

alexa.note: IKEA names Amazon among compatible systems; works via Matter over Thread and needs an Echo that is a Thread border router.

smartthings.note: IKEA names Samsung among compatible systems; works via Matter over Thread and needs a SmartThings hub that is a Thread border router.

home_assistant.note: Via the official Matter integration with a Thread border router. Users also report a Zigbee pairing mode, which we haven't confirmed officially.

hubRequired.note: IKEA says phone control needs a Thread border router, e.g. its DIRIGERA hub. A HomePod, Nest Hub or Thread-capable Echo also works; there's no direct Bluetooth app control.

localControl.note: Matter over Thread runs on the local network without a cloud service.

colorType.note: Colour and white spectrum: full colour plus adjustable white.

summary: IKEA's KAJPLATS range has taken over from TRÅDFRI, so this record covers the KAJPLATS E27 colour and white spectrum bulb rather than TRÅDFRI. It is a 1055-lumen colour bulb that runs Matter over Thread and is Matter-certified. It works with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant through Matter, but it needs a Thread border router such as IKEA's DIRIGERA hub.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router (e.g. IKEA DIRIGERA, HomePod mini, Nest Hub 2nd gen) even for phone control.
Phone control depends on the Thread network: there is no Bluetooth fallback for direct app control.
